reason: I have cooked kra pao and khai jiao for my family for twenty years, so I don't need my phone to tell me when the egg is done. If I ever get stuck, three free questions a day is already more than I would use, so there is nothing here for me to pay for.
objection: 99 baht every month is two dinners of kra pao for my family, and all it buys is more questions. I don't do subscriptions, and my mother or YouTube answers me for free.
would_change_my_mind: If the paid part gave me a week of cook-ahead family dishes for my Sunday cooking, with a shopping list that saves me more than the 99 baht it costs.
